description: Lists open deadlines in the institution's matters due within the next N days (1–90, default 30), with the provision each runs under, flagging those due within 7 days. Open items whose due date passed within the same number of days are listed separately.

days.description: How many days ahead to look, from 1 to 90. Defaults to 30.
